sub: Pick the right size and the cheapest way to pay.

Overview.p: Instance types are grouped by purpose: General (t, m), Compute (c), Memory (r), Storage (i, d), GPU (p, g). Pricing models are On-Demand, Savings Plans or Reserved, Spot and Dedicated Hosts.
Like renting vehicles: a scooter for small jobs, a truck for heavy loads. Pay daily (On-Demand), take a yearly deal (Savings Plan), or grab a cheap leftover seat that can be taken back (Spot).
A company runs steady databases on 1-year Savings Plans, web servers On-Demand, and night video jobs on Spot to save up to about 90%.
T = Tiny burst • M = Middle • C = CPU • R = RAM
